title: 第7章 天罡驱邪咒第8章 你有血光之灾
content_zh:
;;
一叶知修：“……其实你不用说后面这句，年轻人，我看你是体质弱，晚上发电报发多了吧。
须知阳气生发，人精满升阳，你定然是体虚精亏，元阳不足，髓海空乏，又是个足控，这般臆想纤足玉踝，赏玩腿形的妄念，分明是虚阳上浮，相火妄动，引动六欲阴魔所化的鬼境，所谓外鬼易祛，心鬼难防。
这样吧，既然在这论坛上遇上也算有缘，你若是诚心，发二十块红包给我，我传你《天罡驱邪咒》，日诵七遍，自然三尸伏藏，百邪不侵。这是我的联系方式……”
看到一叶知修回复，张唯有些无语，他真的只是客观描述而已，毕竟那女鬼的一双脚到现在都让他印象深刻。
真不是什么腿控。
尽管没事的时候他也喜欢去市中心坐坐，蜀都啥都好，特别是市中心，一旦炎热的夏季就特别养眼。
本想直接退出论坛，但张唯想了想，能发出太上诰忘今章，就算人不行，但所属的道门也应该有点东西才对。
张唯用微讯加了对方联系方式。
一叶知修迅速通过。
张唯也不拖沓，直接发了二十块红包。
一叶知修也很痛快，将天罡驱邪咒的咒语和手印发了出来，并且还附赠了一个教学视频，明显没少干过，末了还留了一句。
“朋友，咒语虽好，但最重要的是，注意节制，锻炼身体方为根本，须知身壮则神强。”
张唯一句话不说，回了个抱拳的表情包。
蜀都青城山上，一名年轻道士乐呵呵地将红包点了，嘴里咕哝着。
“搞定，又得吃二十块，还差三十多就能凑个648了……”
一边算着钱，道士一边挠着头，看着与张唯的对话框，想了想又补充了一句。
“一定要心诚，所谓信则有，不信则无。”
没效果那就是心不诚，这就怪不到他头上了。
“多谢告知。”

-----------------
张唯仔细阅读了下天罡驱邪咒这段咒语。
此咒曰：“天罡耀灵，北斗垂光。魒星指路，魑魅伏藏。焚符破秽，炁摄不祥。丹朱口神，卫我真常！”
又仔细念诵了几遍咒语，确认都背诵下来，又配合手印练得纯熟后，视界上突然跳出一道信息。
‘你学习了天罡驱邪咒（未入门，需日夜念诵百遍，七日方成，心诚则灵）’
看到这他心里忍不住泛起一丝嘀咕，虽然知道是因为脑子里面的肿瘤压迫视觉神经导致了自己一定幻视，表达出了自己潜意识最深层次的想法，但怎么看都觉得是系统。
心诚则灵。
也就是说，你越信，它越真是吧。
张唯也不急于继续进入坐忘，而是认真的继续念诵咒语，手里配合施印。
既然视界上出现提示，那就说明天罡驱邪咒有用，当然得连续念诵七日看看效果。
练了一阵，张唯肚子有些饿了。
下楼在街边点了份回锅肉盖饭。
刚在街边小店门口摆放的桌椅坐下吃了两口头肉，就听得“哎呀”一声惊叫。
迎面走来的端汤的少女脚下莫名绊了下，整碗滚烫的酱汤全泼他前襟。
暗红油污在洗得发白的t恤上晕开，烫得他胸口皮肤火辣辣地疼。
“嘶！”
张唯倒吸一口凉气，连忙将衣服扯下，要是沾得久了，怕是皮都得烫出几个大泡。
“对不起对不起！”

Kazuyo Chihshu: "...Actually, you don't need to say the last sentence. Young man, I think you are weak and have sent too many telegrams at night.
It should be noted that when Yang Qi is growing and human essence is full and Yang is rising, you must be deficient and deficient in essence, insufficient Yuan Yang, empty marrow sea, and have a foot control. Such delusional thoughts about slender feet and jade ankles and admiring the shape of legs are clearly caused by the rising of deficient Yang and the reckless movement of phase fire, which triggers the ghost state transformed by the Yin Demon of Six Desires. The so-called external ghosts are easy to get rid of, but the inner ghosts are difficult to prevent.
Well, since we are destined to meet each other on this forum, if you are sincere, send me 20 red envelopes, and I will teach you the "Tiangang Exorcism Mantra", recite it seven times a day, and naturally the three corpses will hide it, and all evil will not invade. This is my contact information..."
Seeing Yiye Zhixiu's reply, Zhang Wei was a little speechless. He was really just describing it objectively. After all, the female ghost's feet have impressed him so far.
It's really not some kind of leg control.
Although he also likes to go to the city center when he has nothing to do. Everything in Shu is good, especially the city center, which is particularly eye-catching in the hot summer.
He wanted to quit the forum directly, but Zhang Wei thought about it and realized that if he could issue the Imperial Edict to Forget This Chapter, even if he was not good enough, the Taoist sect he belonged to should still have something.
Zhang Wei used WeChat to add the other party’s contact information.
Ichiyo Chishu passed quickly.
Zhang Wei didn't delay and directly handed out twenty yuan in red envelopes.
Ichiyo Chishu was also very happy. He distributed the incantation and fingerprints of the Tiangang Exorcism Curse, and also attached a teaching video. It was obvious that he had done this before, and he even left a sentence at the end.
"Friends, although mantras are good, the most important thing is to pay attention to moderation and exercise the body. You must know that a strong body will make the spirit strong."
Zhang Weiwei didn't say a word, but responded with a fist-clasping emoticon.
On Qingcheng Mountain in the capital of Shu, a young Taoist priest happily lit the red envelope and muttered.
"It's done, I need to eat another twenty yuan, and I still have more than thirty yuan left before I can collect 648..."
While counting the money, the Taoist priest scratched his head, looked at the conversation with Zhang Wei, and added something after thinking for a while.
"You must be sincere. If you believe it, you have it. If you don't believe it, you don't have it."
If it doesn't work, then it's because you're not sincere, so you can't blame him.
"Thanks for letting me know."
------------------
Zhang Wei carefully read the Tiangang Exorcism Curse.
This mantra says: "Tiangang shines brightly, Beidou shines down. The zodiac stars point the way, and evil spirits hide. Burning talismans destroys filth, and Qi captures ominousness. Danzhu mouth god, guard me forever!"
After reciting the incantation carefully several times to make sure it was memorized, and practicing the hand seals proficiently, a message suddenly popped up on the horizon.
'You have learned the Tiangang Exorcism Mantra (you have not yet started, you need to recite it a hundred times day and night, it will take seven days to complete, and your heart will be sincere)'
Seeing this, he couldn't help but murmur in his heart. Although he knew that the tumor in his brain compressed the optic nerve and caused some visual hallucinations, expressing his deepest subconscious thoughts, no matter how he looked at it, he felt that it was a system.
Sincerity leads to spirituality.
In other words, the more you believe it, the more true it is.
Zhang Wei was not in a hurry to continue entering Zuowang, but continued to recite the incantation seriously and cooperated with the sealing in his hands.
Since there is a prompt on the horizon, it means that the Tiangang Exorcism Curse is effective. Of course, you have to recite it continuously for seven days to see the effect.
After practicing for a while, Zhang Wei felt a little hungry.
Went downstairs and ordered a twice-cooked pork rice bowl on the street.
As soon as I sat down at the table and chairs set up in front of the street shop and ate two pieces of meat, I heard a scream of "Oh!"
The girl carrying the soup who was walking towards him stumbled for no apparent reason, and the entire bowl of hot miso soup was poured all over his front.
Dark red oil stains spread on the washed-white T-shirt, causing the skin on his chest to burn.
"Hiss!"
Zhang Wei took a breath of cold air and quickly pulled off his clothes. If it stayed on for a long time, he would probably get a few big blisters on his skin.
"I'm sorry!"
